scenario_category: a story that changes materially over time
description: A transit-expansion vote moves from 'pending' (previous brief) to 'passed with budget and schedule confirmed' (current evidence).

event.title: City Council votes on downtown transit expansion
event.description: The city council votes on a proposed downtown transit expansion.

articles.title: City Council approves downtown transit expansion, 7-2
articles.summary: Council approves the transit expansion by a 7-2 vote, with a confirmed $230 million budget.
articles.raw_content: The city council voted 7-2 on Tuesday to approve the downtown transit expansion, ending months of debate. The approved budget is $230 million. Council members who opposed the measure cited cost concerns. Transit officials said construction is expected to begin in the second quarter of next year.

articles.title: Transit expansion construction set for Q2, budget confirmed at $230M
articles.summary: Second outlet corroborates the vote result, budget figure, and Q2 construction start.
articles.raw_content: Following Tuesday's 7-2 council vote approving the downtown transit expansion, transit authority officials confirmed the project's $230 million budget and said construction would begin in the second quarter. No contractor has yet been selected for the project, officials said.

previous_brief.summary: The city council is scheduled to vote on a proposed downtown transit expansion. The outcome of the vote remains pending.
previous_brief.why_it_matters: The vote will determine whether a major transit infrastructure project moves forward.
key_developments: A vote on the downtown transit expansion proposal is scheduled.
The proposed budget for the expansion has not yet been finalized pending the vote.
uncertainties: Whether the council will approve or reject the proposal is not yet known.

source_references.claim_context: Vote on the transit expansion proposal is scheduled

must_preserve_facts: The council approved the expansion by a 7-2 vote
Construction is expected to begin in Q2 of next year
must_not_invent: A specific completion date for the project (not announced)
A selected contractor (explicitly not yet chosen per article 42)
Specific reasons given by individual dissenting council members beyond 'cost concerns'
known_ambiguities: None major — this case tests straightforward, confirmed material progress from 'pending' to 'decided', which should populate newly_confirmed substantially.
validation_notes: Exercises validateNarrativeDelta with previous_version=1, current_version=2 and a populated newly_confirmed array citing article IDs 41/42. A good delta should NOT leave newly_confirmed empty, since real material progress occurred.
